_design_note: F2, the tournament candidate for submission, and the arm the closing batch was built to reach. It puts the safest recipe measured (M3.10: (128, 64) at 5e-4) on the best tournament setting measured (M3.13: opponent training at 5000 rounds, repeat-measured 2.4293 against M3.4's 2.1436, t = +7.9). Neither has been combined with the other. Note that M3.13 wins on collection, not survival -- its coins_share is the project's highest at 0.2402 while its survival rate is its lowest at 2.8 percent -- so the open question is whether M3.10's safety adds to that or trades against it.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: route R02_3 -> R02_6 relative to M3.13: hidden (64,32) -> (128,64) and learning_rate 1e-3 -> 5e-4. Budget, schedule, task, opponents and seeds are M3.13's.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/m3_13_budget5000_vs3rb_20260827/ -- repeat-measured score 2.4293 (sd 0.057), coins_share 0.2402, survival 2.8 percent
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: Not resolvably above 2.4293 means the retuned width adds nothing on top of opponent training at this budget, and M3.13 is the submission.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: Report all five training-seed distributions, coins_share, the death split, and the five repeat measurements individually.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Single measurements do not settle the tournament suite: docs/01 section 7.20 puts sd at 0.089 and the repeat measurement of M3.4/M3.12/M3.13 puts each arm's own sd at 0.038-0.057. Judge this arm by repeating its classic_versus_opponents suite five times, as those three were.
_predeclared_design_numbers.selection_rule_agreed_in_advance: Submit the arm with the highest repeat-measured tournament score. If no arm is resolvably above M3.13's 2.4293, submit M3.13.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_metric_that_decides_it: Repeat the classic_versus_opponents suite five times and compare the pooled means against M3.13's five, the way M3.4/M3.12/M3.13 were compared. A single measurement of this suite decides nothing. Report coins_share and the death split alongside score.
